lobby.name: Emergency Lobby
lobby.description: Snow drifts against the dark glass. Battery-backed emergency lamps pulse above abandoned reception. Black mould blooms around the vents; a dark drag trail ends beneath the desk.

security.name: Security Office
security.description: Surveillance monitors hum above a cramped security desk. A cold coffee sits beside the controls. The outside locks answer to a remote operator; the local switches have been disabled.

ward.name: Patient Wing
ward.description: The Patient Wing opens around a tiled nurse station. An open night-shift equipment case rests on the counter. Heavy doors lead back to the East Corridor and onward to the North Patient Corridor. A toppled gurney blocks part of the floor.

room12.name: Room 12
room12.description: A single bed, restraints cut. The name on the door has been scratched out and rewritten: J-09. Beneath the frame, someone carved BELA into the metal.

archive.name: The Archives
archive.description: Rows of steel shelving. Every folder bears your name, in handwriting that is not yours.

generator.name: Generator Room
generator.description: The lower facility hums with cold. The generator is dark, its panel missing a fuse. A save terminal and storage box sit by the door.

observation.name: Observation Ward
observation.description: Reinforced viewing windows separate the first-floor observation ward from sealed trial chambers. A records console remains under emergency power. The more heavily scratched pane is isolated behind a yellow floor line.

pharmacy.name: Pharmacy
pharmacy.description: Shelves stripped by panicked hands. Something dripped here recently, and not water.

chapel.name: Hospital Chapel
chapel.description: Candles burn that nobody lit. The pews face a wall of names. It is the only room where the intercom is silent.

morgue.name: Morgue
morgue.description: Rows of steel doors. Some are open. One is warm to the touch.

residence.name: Staff Residence
residence.description: A corridor of staff bedrooms behind a door that was sealed until the power came back. Every bed is made. Every bed has been slept in.

tunnel.name: Flooded Tunnel
tunnel.description: Waist-deep black water. A winch hangs over the flood, and something drags itself in the dark beneath.

boiler.name: Boiler Room
boiler.description: Pipes shudder with heat. The furnace door is fused shut around something that glows the color of an old lullaby.

laundry.name: Laundry & Service Wing
laundry.description: Industrial washers sit open like steel mouths. Damp sheets hang from ceiling rails, dark with old stains. A sour smell rises from clogged drains. Behind the dryers, someone has scratched a route map into the tile.

children.name: Children’s Ward
children.description: Paper stars sag above empty beds. Mold has eaten through the painted clouds; dried food cakes the tray tables. The wall is covered in drawings of Bela holding the hand of a faceless man. Every drawing has the same numeric date.

records.name: Records Annex
records.description: The Records Annex smells of warm paper and stale antiseptic. A researcher’s final notes rest beside a field recorder. A carbon-copy cabinet conceals a photographic lock; no public exit leads through this room.

surgery.name: Surgical Theatre 2
surgery.description: Surgical lamps hang above a table strapped down from the inside. Rust-colored streaks run into the floor drain. The monitors display waveforms for a patient who is not on the table.

isolation.name: Restricted Isolation Room
isolation.description: The glass doors are fogged from the inside. Six beds. Six mirrors turned to the wall. In the dark reflection, one bed is still occupied.

specimen.name: Specimen Laboratory
specimen.description: Glass vials are arranged by voice, not by patient number. A sample in the centre cabinet leans toward the intercom whenever it crackles.

powercontrol.name: Emergency Power Control
powercontrol.description: A secondary control station hums behind a mesh cage. The relay labels have been scraped off and replaced with three terms: SUBJECT X, J-09, and CONTINUITY.

stafflounge.name: Staff Lounge
stafflounge.description: A vending machine glows with no power cable. The staff noticeboard has been wiped clean except for one note in your handwriting.

lift.name: Restricted Service Elevator
lift.description: A freight elevator with a chipped brass floor selector. Its public labels stop at the basement. A steel plate conceals two deeper buttons, rubbed smooth from use. The motor groans as though something is waiting beneath it.

coldstore.name: Cold Storage
coldstore.description: A cold room behind a light-sensitive latch. Rows of labelled evidence bags are frozen into shelves; one has split open around a dark, fibrous mass. One reel bears the word CONTINUITY.

eastcorridor.name: East Corridor
eastcorridor.description: The corridor slopes gently toward the patient wing. Only the emergency EXIT stencil is visible without a light. Someone has dragged a trolley across the tiles; fresh scraping marks end beneath a broken ceiling fixture.

isoward.name: Isolation Treatment Room
isoward.description: Through a narrow glass slot, a conscious patient pleads with someone who is no longer here. Old restraints bind his wrists. A pressure monitor has no power, and the medicine trolley has been dragged out of reach.

wardnorth.name: North Patient Corridor
wardnorth.description: The corridor narrows between patient rooms. A linen trolley has been dragged across the doors. A narrow strip of ceiling lights flickers, failing to dispel the shadows along the baseboards.

wardservice.name: Patient Service Crossroads
wardservice.description: The service passage runs behind the wards. A peeling evacuation diagram connects Pharmacy, Archives and Laundry. Condensation runs down a barred maintenance window.
